from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys
H=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
r=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()); b=Path(r["source"]["path"]).read_bytes()
assert H(b)==r["source"]["sha256"],"source hash"
a,z=r["selection_absolute_byte_range"]; raw=b[a:z]
assert H(raw)==r["selected_sha256"],"selection hash"
for q in r["changes"]:
 s,e=q["start"],q["end"]; assert a<=s<e<=z
 assert b[s:e].hex()==q["before_hex"],"old byte span"
 left=bytes.fromhex(q["left_context_hex"]); right=bytes.fromhex(q["right_context_hex"])
 assert b[s-len(left):s]==left and b[e:e+len(right)]==right,"exact context"
 if "prefix_sha256" in q:assert H(b[a:s])==q["prefix_sha256"] and H(b[e:z])==q["suffix_sha256"],"retained prefix/suffix"
 if "replacement_from" in q:
  c=q["replacement_from"]; v=Path(c["path"]).read_bytes(); assert H(v)==c["sha256"],"OCR evidence hash"
  assert v[c["start"]:c["end"]].hex()==q["replacement_hex"],"OCR numeral slice"
out=raw
for q in reversed(r["changes"]):out=out[:q["start"]-a]+bytes.fromhex(q["replacement_hex"])+out[q["end"]-a:]
assert H(out)==r["output_sha256"] and len(out)==r["output_byte_size"],"output hash/extent"
assert out.count(b"\n")==raw.count(b"\n"),"LF count"
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_bytes(out)
